findings.source_passage: A grin brightened his face. He leaned forward and captured my lips in a searing kiss that spoke his happiness louder than any words. We broke apart so I could get some air. At this rate he was going to suffocate me. Even he was a little short as he studied me with his teasing smile.
findings.source_locator: Paragraph 8, after 'You think I'd lie to you after I just saved your scaly skin?'
findings.why_it_matters: The narrator's comic aside ('At this rate he was going to suffocate me') is a register-defining voice beat that characterizes Miriam's dry humor and grounds the romantic moment; the draft collapses this to 'he still looked a little breathless' without the self-aware commentary.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the narrator's parenthetical observation about nearly being suffocated; this is the kind of wry aside that establishes the narrator's voice throughout the book and should not be smoothed away.

findings.source_passage: I stopped my perusing and curtain measurements to frown at him. 'This isn't your place?'
findings.source_locator: Paragraph 12, after 'the High Castle is not my home'
findings.why_it_matters: The 'curtain measurements' bit is a small comic-domestic detail that reveals Miriam's personality — she's already mentally redecorating — and is the kind of quirky character-voice moment that makes the narrator distinct; its removal flattens her characterization.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the stage business of Miriam 'perusing and taking curtain measurements' before she turns to frown at him; it is a brief but voice-rich gesture.

findings.source_passage: My mind imagined a stone hovel in some distant land. I cringed. 'So where is your kingdom?'
findings.source_locator: Paragraph 13, before 'A moment and I will show you'
findings.why_it_matters: Miriam's mental image of a 'stone hovel' is a small comic-ironic beat that shows her dry wit and class-conscious humor; its omission slightly thins the narrator's comedic voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the brief aside about imagining a stone hovel before Miriam asks where his kingdom is.

findings.source_passage: I sat on the edge of the bed with my legs dangling over as she handed the paper to Xander. He unfurled the paper across his lap. A large, browned map spread out before him. The rough leather was covered from corner-to-corner with seas, mountains, oceans, lakes, and so much more.
findings.why_it_matters: The specific physical detail ('legs dangling over,' 'corner-to-corner') gives the scene tactile grounding; the draft compresses it to a single clause losing the visual specificity.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the image of Miriam sitting with her legs dangling and the fuller map description with its list of geographic features.

summary: No high-severity signature losses found; two medium-severity voice flattenings (the 'suffocate me' comic aside and the 'curtain measurements' characterization beat) slightly thin the narrator's voice but do not individually or collectively trigger regeneration.
